name: @g-1/devtools
description: G1 Development Tools - Monorepo containing util, workflow, and test packages

scripts.build: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' build && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' build && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' build && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' build
scripts.test: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' test && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' test && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' test && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' test
scripts.test:ci: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' test:ci && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' test:ci && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' test:ci && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' test:ci
scripts.lint: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' lint && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' lint && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' lint && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' lint:fix && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' lint:fix && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' lint:fix && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' typecheck && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' typecheck && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' typecheck && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' typecheck
scripts.clean: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' clean && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' clean && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' clean && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' clean
scripts.dev: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' dev & bun run --filter='@g-1/util' dev & bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' dev & bun run --filter='@g-1/test' dev & wait
scripts.size-check: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' size-check && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' size-check && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' size-check && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' size-check
scripts.analyze: bun run --filter='@g-1/ai-core' analyze && bun run --filter='@g-1/util' analyze && bun run --filter='@g-1/workflow' analyze && bun run --filter='@g-1/test' analyze
scripts.ci:optimized: bun run typecheck && bun run test:ci && bun run build && bun run size-check && bun run analyze
